names: the covenant phase also targets every other exhibit of a located filing whose own title names a contract that governs debt (one the gate admits for a word other than a guaranty, pledge or security word: a credit, loan, financing or receivables agreement, an indenture, notes, a facility, or an amendment of any), right after its filing's primary exhibit, and one that cannot be read, which reads fetch_failed; the rest are read only for who they are; every target is read by the coverage rule, whose reader now also binds a term defined in the parenthetical at an agreement's date, however long its history, and reads the passive operative clause "The <term> is, ..., hereby amended and restated" as a restatement of the whole agreement, so VRRM's 2025 term-loan restatement is sent and supersedes the 2021 one; and two exhibits of one filing never share a governing group: where they share a label each governs its own group, labelled with its file (STATE row 63)
